messages.author: 9b006333796be6eb
messages.subject: spec() amplitude units
parts:
Hi,

I am using spec() on acceleration data (unit: m/s2).

code: 

spec(wave=data, wn ="hanning", f=sampfreq, norm=F, wl=windowlen, plot=F)

My question is, given the output of this function call, are the units of "amplitude" (y-axis) the same as in the original data passed to the "wave" parameter (i.e m/s2)? 

Thanks

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] spec() amplitude units
parts:
Hi,

By default, the spectrum amplitude is scaled by its maximum but you
can turn the argument norm to FALSE to get not scaled amplitude values.

Jerome
